name: greasepencil
description: DIY garage and auto maintenance tracker. React SPA, Express API, Docker Compose.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node scripts/migrate.mjs
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
